workload: student32 BF16, one v6e chip, batch 1, seq128, all weights resident within a call; nine forwards per call, first discarded, eight different inputs measured
timing: First four variants: 10 calls, 80 measured forwards each, region tracing. Last variant: fresh process, canonical detailed custom-call tracing, 3 calls and 24 measured forwards. Preload and warmup excluded.
correctness: Before timing, compare every output element (9 x 8 x 128 = 9216) bitwise with original VMEM implementation, including action outputs; all variants pass. Existing JAX softmax error threshold 0.02 also checked; this is eight-input smoke validation, not task accuracy evaluation.
implementation: Grouped embedding collects eight independent gathered rows then performs one aligned store. Grouped heads expose two QK/softmax paths before consuming their PVs; precision unchanged. Original defaults preserved for reproducible baseline.
command_template: PYTHONPATH=src TPU_VISIBLE_CHIPS=0 TPU_PROCESS_BOUNDS=1,1,1 TPU_CHIPS_PER_PROCESS_BOUNDS=1,1,1 LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS="--xla_enable_custom_call_region_trace=true" <python> student32_resident_profile.py checkpoint --out optimization-20261017/<variant> --steps 10 --backends vmem --embed-group <1-or-8> --head-group <1-or-2>
checks: Python compilation passed for three benchmark scripts
all four variants and detailed profile passed bitwise output equality against original VMEM implementation
detailed_profile_note: Canonical detailed trace confirms 32.717539 us median vs 32.555 us in lighter region trace. Changed compiler schedule means first MXU timestamp is not a standalone embedding latency; instruction-union coverage cannot establish improved hardware utilization.
